name: discord
description: Send messages and read channels/guilds with a Discord bot token (Bot auth via secretHeaders). Load for posting messages, reading channel history, and listing guild channels.

content.inline:
## Discord
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://discord.com/api/v10` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN"}`. Store the secret as the complete header value `Bot <token>` (create a bot at discord.com/developers -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token; invite it to the server with the scopes you need). Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Bot identity: `GET /users/@me`
- List guilds the bot is in: `GET /users/@me/guilds`
- Guild channels: `GET /guilds/{guild_id}/channels`
- Channel messages: `GET /channels/{channel_id}/messages?limit=50`
- Send a message: `POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages` body `{content}` (or `{embeds: [...]}`)

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors carry `{code, message}`. 401 = bad token; 403 = the bot lacks the channel/guild permission; 429 = rate limited, honour `retry_after`.
- The bot only sees guilds it has been invited to and channels its role can read. Ids are snowflakes (long numeric strings).
